description: This file defines the 'ProductImages' class, which extends 'ContentFiles' and includes a productId field with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductImages
classes.description: Represents product image data associated with a particular product, extending ContentFiles.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product associated with these images.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with these images.
